projectDescription: A self-hosted registry for Skills, MCP Servers, and Plugins that a coding agent loads — publish, discover, and install them from a web interface or CLI, under your own infrastructure.
keyFeatures: Self-hosted registry for Skills, MCP Servers, and Plugins
CLI (skillset) for publish, install, search, update, and remove
MCP server exposing catalog and install tools to coding agents
Unauthenticated catalog reads; role-gated writes (reader / writer / admin / superadmin)
Import Skills and Plugins from GitHub or GitLab repositories
Lockfile (skillset-lock.json) tracking installed Skill state (current / outdated / modified / missing)
Full-text + trigram fuzzy search backed by PostgreSQL pg_trgm
Identity Providers: Google Workspace, Microsoft Entra, GitHub OAuth
S3-compatible object storage for Skill and Plugin artifacts
Submission workflow for community-sourced Skills pending admin approval
Tag catalog for browsing and filtering across all resource kinds
Analytics with install-trend charts per resource
Marketplace endpoint (/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json) for native agent discovery
publicApiSurface: POST /api/imports/:provider/skill-files — fetch skill files from a git provider
POST /api/imports/:provider/skills — list skill folders from a git provider
PUT /api/submissions/:kind/:name — submit a resource for approval
skillset login — authenticate CLI against a registry
skillset publish [path|url] — publish skill(s) to the registry
skillset install <name|url> — install a skill for a coding agent
skillset list — show installed skills and their status
skillset search [query] — search the registry catalog
skillset info <name> — read a skill without installing it
skillset whoami — show current registry and identity
MCP tool: search_skills — search the registry catalog
MCP tool: read_skill — read a skill's SKILL.md and file list
MCP tool: install_skills — install one or more skills
MCP tool: publish_skill — publish a skill to the registry
MCP tool: installed_skills — list installed skills with status
MCP tool: update_skills — re-download outdated skills
MCP resource: skillset://skills/{name} — one skill's SKILL.md body
MCP resource: skillset://tags/{tag} — skills carrying a tag
